content: Signal No. 1: Tropical cyclone winds of 39-61 km/h expected within 36 hours.
Signal No. 2: Winds of 62-88 km/h expected within 24 hours. Preemptive evacuation for coastal areas.
DUCK, COVER, & HOLD: Drop to your hands and knees, cover your head under a sturdy desk or table, and hold on until shaking stops.
